title.zh: 计数表是计数的全部规律
title.en: The tally is the whole law of counting

statement.zh: 计数表是计数的全部规律：列出的计数恰是计数表。八个前提的每个选择之下，计数表之外唯一多出的规律是没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起，恰在选择约束计数时；前提起约束时至多再加三条。
statement.en: The tally is the whole law of counting: listings count exactly the tallies. Under each selection of the eight premises the only law added to the tally is that nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active, exactly where the selection binds counting; binding adds at most three more.

laws.zh: 一个规定每步的成立者被不重复地列出且可判定时，跨每一步保持一些成员：它们连同跨步不再成立的成员是步前的列表，连同跨步开始成立的成员是步后的列表；普查的平衡由此推出。
laws.en: Where the members of which a determination holds are listed at each step, each once, and the determination is decided, across each step some members are kept: with the members ceasing to be across it they are the list before the step, and with the members coming to be the list after it; the census balance follows from it.

laws.zh: 称每步的数目 n、跨步不再成立的数目 c 与开始成立的数目 a 为计数表，若每步有某数 k 使 n t = k + c t 且 n (t+1) = k + a t；每个列出的计数都是计数表。
laws.en: Call counts n at each step, c ceasing and a coming across it a tally when at each step some number k has n t = k + c t and n (t + 1) = k + a t; the counts of every listing are a tally.

laws.zh: 计数表严格强于普查的平衡 n (t+1) + c t = n t + a t：计数表恰是平衡加上跨一步不再成立的不多于步前所列的；每步零个在列、一个不再成立、一个开始成立满足平衡而不是计数表。
laws.en: The tally is strictly stronger than the census balance n (t + 1) + c t = n t + a t: it is exactly the balance with no more ceasing across a step than were listed before it, and none listed with one ceasing and one coming at every step balances and is no tally.

laws.zh: 反过来，每个计数表都由一个队列实现：自然数作为成员，第 t 步在队中的是从此前离开的总数起的 n t 个，从队尾加入、从队首离开，各依其次；它被不重复地列出，每步列出 n t 个，跨步离开 c t 个、加入 a t 个。
laws.en: Conversely every tally is counted by a queue: with natural numbers as members, at step t the queue holds n t members from the number that have left before, members joining at the back and leaving from the front, each in turn; it is listed, each member once, with n t listed at each step, c t leaving and a t joining across it.

laws.zh: 所以列出所能有的计数恰是计数表，对计数的一个性质（只要求尊重每步的值），在每个类型上每个列出的计数都满足它，恰当每个计数表都满足它：计数没有计数表之外的规律。
laws.en: So the counts some listing has are exactly the tallies, and a property of the counts, asked only to respect their values at each step, holds of the counts of every listing on every type exactly when it holds of every tally: counting has no law beyond the tally.

laws.zh: 读于世界的活动：成员排队而什么都不流动的世界满足除体现外的全部前提（活动需要支持、平衡、只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用其所汲取的、耗散、普查、有界传递），成员排队且恰在活跃时立着的世界满足除平衡外的全部前提。
laws.en: Read of the activity of worlds: relata queuing with nothing flowing meet every premise but embodiment (activity needing support, balance, only active relata giving, only active relata taking what they draw on, dissipation, a census, bounded transmission), and relata queuing that stand exactly while active meet every premise but balance.

laws.zh: 所以对计数的一个性质在每个世界的每个普查中成立，恰当它对每个计数表成立，也恰当它在满足除体现外全部前提的每个世界中成立，也恰当它在满足除平衡外全部前提的每个世界中成立：缺平衡或缺体现的前提不约束计数。
laws.en: So a property of the counts holds of every census of every world exactly when it holds of every tally, and exactly when it holds in every world meeting every premise but embodiment, and exactly when it holds in every world meeting every premise but balance: premises lacking balance or embodiment leave counting free.

laws.zh: 两者连同只有活跃者给予一起约束：在平衡、只有活跃者给予且生起者体现的世界中，生起者由一个在该步活跃的关系项给予，所以普查之下，没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起；而一个关系项从无到有地生起是计数表，由两个队列世界实现，所以这不是计数的规律。
laws.en: With only active relata giving, the two bind it together: in a world whose flow balances, in which only active relata give and whatever arises is embodied, what arises is given by a relatum active at the step, so under a census nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active; one relatum arising from none is a tally, counted by both queue worlds, so this is no law of counting.

laws.zh: 八个前提所加的只有这一条：开放的队列，队首给予每个加入者一个单位、从每个离开者取用一个单位，活跃时与每个地关系项各交换一个单位，在没有成员加入空队的每个计数表之下满足全部八个前提。
laws.en: That is all the eight premises add: an open queue, whose front gives one unit to each relatum joining, takes one from each leaving and, while active, exchanges a unit each way with every ground relatum, meets all eight premises under every tally in which nothing joins an empty queue.

laws.zh: 开放的队列中，队首活跃的步上没有有限家族封闭，队空的步上什么都不交换，所以耗散从不起约束，活动需要支持与有界传递也不起约束。
laws.en: In the open queue no finite family is closed at a step at which the front is active, and nothing is exchanged at a step at which the queue is empty, so dissipation never binds there, nor do activity needing support and bounded transmission.

laws.zh: 所以对计数的一个性质在满足全部八个前提的每个世界的普查中成立，恰当它对每个没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起的计数表成立。
laws.en: So a property of the counts holds of the census of every world meeting all eight exactly when it holds of every tally in which nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active.

laws.zh: 这一刻画的范围包括前提空成立的世界：在每个前提都起约束的世界中，每个普查都计到某个生起，而这在八个前提之下不是计数的规律。
laws.en: Its range includes worlds in which premises hold vacuously: where every premise binds, every census counts something arising, which is no law of counting under the eight.

laws.zh: 约束计数还有第二条路线，不要求给予者活跃：在平衡、只有活跃者取用其所汲取的、耗散且关系项都体现的世界中，普查之下没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起，不论谁给予。
laws.en: A second route binds counting without asking the giver to be active: in a world whose flow balances and dissipates, in which only active relata take and only from what they draw on and every relatum is embodied, under a census nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active, whoever gives.

laws.zh: 按这条路线，那一步上什么都不被取用，被给予的立起而在步后活跃，所以步后活跃者是一个封闭的家族，耗散不许不取用而给予它。
laws.en: By that route nothing is taken at that step, whatever is given comes to stand and is active after it, so the relata active after it form a closed family, to which dissipation lets nothing be given without taking.

laws.zh: 把八个前提命名，一个选择是到 Bool 的函数，世界满足它所选的每个前提；称一个选择约束计数，若它选中平衡与体现，并选中只有活跃者给予，或同时选中只有活跃者取用与耗散。
laws.en: With the eight premises named, a selection is a function to Bool, and a world meets it when it meets every premise selected; a selection binds counting when it selects balance and embodiment, and either only active relata giving or both only active relata taking and dissipation.

laws.zh: 由一个从不活跃的地关系项驱动的队列不论计数都满足除只有活跃者给予与只有活跃者取用外的全部前提，开放的队列不论计数都满足除只有活跃者给予与耗散外的全部前提；连同两个队列世界，它们满足每个不约束计数的选择，满足全部八个前提的世界满足每个选择。
laws.en: Whatever its counts, a queue driven by a ground relatum never active meets every premise but only active relata giving and taking, and the open queue every premise but only active relata giving and dissipation; with the two queue worlds they meet every selection that does not bind counting, and a world meeting all eight meets every selection.

laws.zh: 所以在八个前提的 256 个选择的每一个之下，对计数的一个逐点的性质在满足这个选择的每个世界的每个普查中成立，恰当它对每个计数表成立，且在选择约束计数时对每个没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起的计数表成立；“没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起”在一个选择之下是计数的规律，恰当这个选择约束计数。
laws.en: So under each of the 256 selections of the eight premises, a pointwise property of the counts holds of every census of every world meeting the selection exactly when it holds of every tally and, where the selection binds counting, of every tally in which nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active; that law is a law of counting under a selection exactly when the selection binds counting.

laws.zh: 每个前提都起约束，即每个前提的条件都有实例时，每个普查都计到某个生起，而起约束所加的只有这一条。
laws.en: Where every premise binds, each premise's condition having an instance, every census counts something arising, and that is all binding adds.

laws.zh: 只闭合一次的队列在除第 T 步外、步前或步后队列不空的每一步上，队首与每个关系项各交换一个单位，所以没有有限的家族封闭这些步；在第 T 步上队首多立着 E，只在队中交换并失去它，所以所立者下降，跨度封闭这一步而耗散起约束。
laws.en: Across every step but T at which a queue closed once is not empty before or after, its front exchanges one unit each way with every relatum, so no finite family closes those steps; at T the front stands E more, exchanges only within the queue and loses that excess, so what stands falls, the span closes the step and dissipation binds.

laws.zh: 每个关系项以其所立的水平依存于每个关系项，所以活动需要支持与有界传递的条件在有成员加入处有实例；但这两个前提在这里对任何活动、任何流都成立，只在有实例的意义上起约束，排除什么的只有耗散。
laws.en: Every relatum depends on every relatum at what it stands at, so the conditions of activity needing support and bounded transmission have instances wherever a member joins; but there these two premises hold whatever is active and whatever flows, binding only as instances, and only dissipation excludes anything.

laws.zh: 没有成员加入空队、E 多于第 T 步加入的数目时，它满足全部八个前提；第 T 步队列不空、E 多于第 T 步加入的数目且某步有成员加入时，每个前提都起约束，不论有没有成员加入空队。
laws.en: With nothing joining an empty queue and E more than join across T it meets all eight premises; with the queue not empty at T, E more than join across T and something joining across some step, every premise binds, whether or not something joins an empty queue.

laws.zh: 所以在每个前提都起约束的世界中，八个前提之下对计数的一个逐点的性质在每个普查中成立，恰当它对每个有某个生起、且没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起的计数表成立。
laws.en: So in worlds in which every premise binds, a pointwise property of the counts holds under the eight of every census exactly when it holds of every tally with something arising and nothing arising across a step at which nothing is active.

laws.zh: 没有有限世界使每个前提都起约束，普查起约束要求世界不有限；去掉 hatch 闲置的地关系项，得到满足八个前提的有限世界，其中除普查外每个前提都起约束。
laws.en: No finite world binds every premise, a census binding only where the world is not finite; without the idle ground of hatch there is a finite world meeting the eight in which every premise but the census binds.

laws.zh: 有限世界中除普查外每个前提都起约束时，八个前提之下对计数的一个逐点的性质在每个普查中成立，恰当它对每个没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起、从第 0 步起有变化界、且有某个生起的计数表成立；见证是有限的队列把依存网饱和。
laws.en: In finite worlds where every premise but the census binds, a pointwise property of the counts holds under the eight of every census exactly when it holds of every tally with nothing arising across a step at which nothing is active, a change bound from the first step and something arising, the finite queue with its web saturated witnessing it.

laws.zh: 每个选择 S 之下，对计数的一个逐点的性质在满足 S 且 S 所选的每个前提都起约束的每个世界的每个普查中成立，恰当它对每个这样的计数表成立：S 约束计数时没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起；S 选中活动需要支持、只有活跃者给予或只有活跃者取用时有关系项活跃；S 选中体现时有某个生起；S 选中体现、只有活跃者给予与有界传递时在有关系项活跃的一步上有生起。
laws.en: Under each selection S, a pointwise property of the counts holds of every census of every world meeting S in which each premise S selects binds exactly when it holds of every tally in which nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active where S binds counting, something is active where S selects activity needing support, only active relata giving or only active relata taking, something arises where S selects embodiment, and something arises across a step at which something is active where S selects embodiment, only active relata giving and bounded transmission.

laws.zh: 所以起约束所加的，恰是有关系项活跃（选中活动需要支持、只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用或体现时）、有某个生起（选中体现时）与在有关系项活跃的一步上有生起（选中体现，且选择约束计数或选中只有活跃者给予与有界传递时）。
laws.en: So binding adds exactly that something is active (where activity needing support, only active relata giving, only active relata taking or embodiment is selected), that something arises (where embodiment is), and that something arises across a step at which something is active (where embodiment is selected and the selection binds counting or selects only active relata giving and bounded transmission).

laws.zh: 见证：把依存网饱和，每个关系项以其所立的水平依存于每个关系项，活动需要支持就对任何活动成立，水平有界时有界传递对任何流成立。
laws.en: The witnesses rest on a saturated web, every relatum depending on every relatum at what it stands at, under which activity needing support holds whatever is active and, with levels bounded, bounded transmission whatever flows.

laws.zh: 不选体现时，一个传递在队列旁把两个单位之一交给一个地关系项，失去另一个；选中体现而不选平衡时，有损的队列的队首跨一步与自身及每个加入者各交换一个单位，再失去一个单位，所立者不记录这些；选中平衡与体现时，只闭合一次的队列与饱和的开放队列。
laws.en: Without embodiment, a relay beside a queue hands one of two units on to a ground relatum and loses the other; with embodiment but not balance, a lossy queue's front, across one step, exchanges a unit each way with itself and each member joining and loses one unit more, which no standing records; with balance and embodiment, the queue closed once and the open queue with its web saturated.

laws.zh: 被围住时计数还受一个变化界约束；有限世界中每个选择之下计数还有界，耗散连同平衡与体现就约束计数（counting-under-enclosure）。
laws.en: Under enclosure change is also bounded; in finite worlds under each selection the count is bounded too, and dissipation with balance and embodiment binds counting (counting-under-enclosure).

laws.zh: 保持对每个世界有局部形式，只用一步两端的列出；Listed.keeps 是它的推论。
laws.en: Keeping holds of every world in a local form, using only the listings at the step's two ends; Listed.keeps is its corollary.

laws.zh: 取用对计数的约束对每个世界的确切形式见 laws-of-one-step，World.taking_binds_counting 是它的推论。
laws.en: The exact form for every world of the binding of counting by taking is in laws-of-one-step, of which World.taking_binds_counting is a corollary.

hypotheses.zh: 列出与可判定：同 census-balance；读于世界时是活动可判定。这是表示的逻辑承诺。
hypotheses.en: Listing and decidability: as in census-balance; read of worlds, decided activity. It is a logical commitment of the representation.

hypotheses.zh: 逐点（Pointwise）：性质尊重计数每步的值。有函数外延性时每个性质都如此；纯净核心不假设它，所以作为定理的假设陈述；不用它的刻画是 tally_iff_counted。
hypotheses.en: Pointwise: the property respects the counts' values at each step. With function extensionality every property does; the pure core does not assume it, so it is a hypothesis of the theorems; tally_iff_counted states the characterization without it.

does_not_show.zh: 只对每步有限的成立者陈述。
does_not_show.en: Stated for holders finitely many at each step.

does_not_show.zh: 只说计数，不说哪个成员进入或离开，也不说关系。
does_not_show.en: It speaks only of counts, saying neither which member enters or leaves nor anything of relations.

does_not_show.zh: 队列世界与选择之下的见证都有无限多个关系项，每个只生起一次；依存网是饱和的，即最弱的，有损的队列不平衡，传递不体现，它们只用作见证。
does_not_show.en: The queue worlds and the witnesses under the selections have infinitely many relata, each arising once; their webs are saturated, the weakest, the lossy queue unbalanced and the relay not embodied, and they serve only as witnesses.

does_not_show.zh: 有限世界中与被围住时计数的规律，以及有限世界中每个选择之下所选前提都起约束时的规律（World.finite_binding_counting_under），见 counting-under-enclosure。
does_not_show.en: The laws of counting in finite worlds and under enclosure, and in finite worlds where the premises of each selection bind (World.finite_binding_counting_under), are in counting-under-enclosure.

does_not_show.zh: 读于世界只陈述了活动的计数：水平与依存的计数由一般的 counting_laws 给出，前提之下的规律见 counting-standing-and-dependence。
does_not_show.en: Read of worlds only the counting of activity is stated: the counts of standing and dependence are covered by counting_laws, and their laws under the premises are in counting-standing-and-dependence.

does_not_show.zh: 其范围包括前提空成立的世界：开放的队列中耗散、活动需要支持与有界传递都空成立。
does_not_show.en: The range includes worlds in which premises hold vacuously: in the open queue dissipation, activity needing support and bounded transmission all hold vacuously.

does_not_show.zh: 起约束是条件有实例；排除表示所允许者的更强的起约束读法之下的规律没有陈述；这一读法不采用，留作比较。
does_not_show.en: Binding is an instance of each condition; the laws under a stronger reading of binding, in which each premise excludes something the representation allows, are not stated; that reading is not adopted and is kept for comparison.

detail.zh: Queue.lone_tally 与 World.queue、World.embodiedQueue：一个关系项从无到有地生起，满足除体现外或除平衡外的全部前提，所以“没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起”不是计数的规律，只在平衡与体现一起之下成立。
detail.en: Queue.lone_tally with World.queue and World.embodiedQueue: one relatum arising from none, meeting every premise but embodiment or every premise but balance, so ‘nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active’ is no law of counting and holds only under balance and embodiment together.

detail.zh: balance_not_tally：每步零个在列、一个不再成立、一个开始成立满足平衡而不是计数表，没有列出有这样的计数；所以全部规律是计数表，不是平衡的等式。
detail.en: balance_not_tally: none listed, with one ceasing and one coming at every step, balances and is no tally, and no listing has these counts; so the whole law is the tally, not the balance equation.

detail.zh: World.openQueue_not_binds 与 World.binds_adds：premised_counting 的见证中耗散、活动需要支持与有界传递空成立；只取每个前提都起约束的世界，每个普查都计到某个生起，这在八个前提之下不是规律。
detail.en: World.openQueue_not_binds and World.binds_adds: in the witness of premised_counting dissipation, activity needing support and bounded transmission hold vacuously; restricted to worlds in which every premise binds, every census counts an arising, which is no law under the eight.

detail.zh: World.drivenQueue 与 World.openQueue_holds：选中平衡、体现与耗散，而只有活跃者给予与只有活跃者取用都不选时，由不活跃的地关系项驱动的队列实现每个计数表；选中平衡、体现与只有活跃者取用，而只有活跃者给予与耗散都不选时，开放的队列实现每个计数表。所以第二条路线的取用与耗散缺一不可。
detail.en: World.drivenQueue and World.openQueue_holds: with balance, embodiment and dissipation selected but neither only active relata giving nor only active relata taking, the queue driven by an inactive ground relatum counts every tally; with balance, embodiment and only active relata taking selected but neither only active relata giving nor dissipation, the open queue counts every tally. So the second route needs both taking and dissipation.

detail.zh: World.binding_counting：只闭合一次的队列满足全部八个前提且每个都起约束，实现每个有某个生起、且没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起的计数表；所以三个前提在开放的队列中空成立（World.openQueue_not_binds）并没有藏起更多的计数规律。起约束只是条件有实例：这个队列中活动需要支持与有界传递对任何活动、任何流都成立（OnceClosedQueue.dependent_any_activity、OnceClosedQueue.transmits_any_flow）。
detail.en: World.binding_counting: queues closed once meet all eight premises with each binding and count every tally with something arising and nothing arising across a step at which nothing is active; so the three premises holding vacuously in the open queue (World.openQueue_not_binds) hide no further law of counting. Binding is only an instance of each condition: in this queue activity needing support and bounded transmission hold whatever is active and whatever flows (OnceClosedQueue.dependent_any_activity, OnceClosedQueue.transmits_any_flow).

detail.zh: World.Finite.not_binds 与 World.finiteHatch_binds_but_census：没有有限世界使每个前提都起约束；去掉闲置的地关系项的 hatch 是有限世界，满足八个前提，除普查外每个前提都起约束。所以 binding_counting 只涉及不有限的世界；有限世界中除普查外每个前提都起约束时的规律由 World.finite_binding_counting 给出。
detail.en: World.Finite.not_binds and World.finiteHatch_binds_but_census: no finite world binds every premise; hatch without its idle ground is a finite world meeting the eight in which every premise but the census binds. So binding_counting concerns worlds that are not finite; the laws in finite worlds where every premise but the census binds are given by World.finite_binding_counting.

correspondence.zh: 完整的陈述（P23）说，整体的规律除了表示本身所排除的，不排除任何展开。对计数，本结果使这一点精确：计数的规律不排除任何计数表，所以从计数本身推不出关于展开的任何更多的东西。开放纲领中的“对整个空间成立的规律的完整清单”在计数的部分由此给出。前提的地图（map-of-premises）表明八个前提彼此独立；本结果说明它们中的哪些约束计数、约束什么：在 256 个选择的每一个之下计数的规律只有两种，缺平衡或缺体现的任何一组都不约束，两者连同只有活跃者给予，或连同只有活跃者取用与耗散，约束同一条，而全部八个所加的也只有这一条，即使每个都起约束，也只多出有某个生起，这一条来自体现起约束的条件本身；更多的约束来自被围住：停息定理（ceasing-needs-arising、continued-change-needs-openness）在被围住之下使计数归于停息不能被否证，被围住时计数的全部规律再加一个变化界（counting-under-enclosure）。作者的读法（AI 论证）：在场者的数目只记录进入与离开相抵；展开怎样改变这些数目，来自给予与取用的关系，即平衡与体现一起所说的：生起需要一个在场的给予者；或者，在只有活跃者取用与耗散之下，一个封闭的关系不能不取用而给予，生起需要从在场者那里取得。这是活动的计数，英文名称 arising/ceasing 经 Ren 确认（2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names；中文 生起／止息 是 AI 的译名）；它不是 Ren 提议中的“生成的”“退化的”（Ren 写道“generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧”，以“吧”预设二者不重叠，所以这一读法不是其所指；二者读作对能形成者的扩大与缩小，DELEGATED-CHOICES D2）；它也不评价生起或止息。
correspondence.en: The full statement (P23) says that the laws of the whole exclude no unfolding beyond what the representation itself excludes. For counting this result makes it precise: the laws of counting exclude no tally, so nothing more about an unfolding follows from counting alone. The open programme's ‘complete list of the laws holding of the whole space’ is thereby given for counting. The map of premises (map-of-premises) shows the eight premises independent; this result says which of them constrain counting, and how: under each of the 256 selections the laws of counting are of two kinds; no set lacking balance or embodiment constrains it, the two with only active relata giving, or with only active relata taking and dissipation, add the same law, and all eight add nothing more, and with each of them binding only that something arises, which comes from the condition of embodiment binding by itself; further constraint comes from enclosure: under it the rest theorem (ceasing-needs-arising, continued-change-needs-openness) leaves counting unrefuted to come to rest, and the whole law of counting under enclosure adds a change bound (counting-under-enclosure). The author's reading (an AI argument): the number present records only that entering and leaving balance; how an unfolding changes these numbers comes from the relations of giving and taking, which is what balance and embodiment say together: arising needs a giver present; or, with only active relata taking and dissipation, a closed relation cannot give without taking, and arising needs a taking from what is present. This is the counting of activity, whose English names arising and ceasing Ren confirmed (2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names; the Chinese 生起／止息 being the AI's rendering); it is not the proposal's generative and degenerative (Ren wrote ‘generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧’, a tag question presuming that they do not overlap, so this reading is not what is meant; they read as widening and narrowing what can form, DELEGATED-CHOICES D2); it evaluates neither arising nor ceasing.
